response.text: {"title":"Why large beta stalls training","body":"At large beta the residual β·u_x dominates and changes sharply with small weight changes, so the loss surface becomes rugged and gradient steps stall in a poor region. At beta=1 the landscape is smooth and easy. Training there first, then raising beta in stages, starts each stage near a good solution, so the optimizer only needs small, tractable moves (Krishnapriyan et al. 2021).","explanation_index":0,"citation_id":"krishnapriyan2021"}
